metadata.title: Upper bounds for packings of cylinders around the unit sphere
metadata.abstract: In this note we study the problem of packing infinite circular cylinders tangent to the unit sphere. For a given number of cylinders $N$, $N\geq 3$, the maximal common cylinder radius $R_N$ is the maximum $R$ for which there exist $N$ circular cylinders of radius $R$ with non-overlapping interiors, all tangent to the unit sphere. In 1990, Kuperberg conjectured that there does not exist a packing of more than 6 cylinders of radius one tangent to the unit sphere, that is, $R_7<1$. This conjecture was recently confirmed by an exhaustive computer-assisted case analysis. Here we prove new bounds for $R_N$ for small $N$ by considering an auxiliary configuration of spherical quadrilaterals. In particular, we provide a short geometric proof of Kuperberg's conjecture and show that $R_7<0.9978$.

analysis.workSummary: 研究N≥3个无限圆柱同时外切单位球且内部不相交时的最大公共半径R_N。作者借辅助球面四边形构型给出小N的新上界，特别给出Kuperberg的R₇<1猜想的简短几何证明并强化为R₇<0.9978。
analysis.breakthrough: 将已由穷尽计算机分类确认的R₇<1转为较短几何论证，并有显式数值改进。
analysis.limitations: 0.9978是严格上界，不是R₇精确值或最优性结论；猜想此前已有证明，不应宣称首次解决。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
